note: Every bounded failure this field has, in one document, and none of them rejects. Four ids exceed the limit of three, so the fourth (`cart`) is truncated away — note that truncation happens BEFORE resolution, so a site cannot name six, have three fail and quietly receive its fourth choice. Of the three that survive the cap, the repeated `catalog` is dropped first-wins and `wishlist` names no declared item. What remains is one id. `cart` therefore does not appear in the dock even though it is a perfectly valid item, which is the correct reading of a manifest that asked for four things: the site is over its budget, and the browser bounds rather than chooses.
